information.description:
Rough-and-tumble bodyguards wider than a door, often sent to protect high ranking members of the Tyger Claws. Ozekis are brutal in hand to hand combat, even if they aren’t the brightest of the pride.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Tyger Claws).

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
Throwing hands, does not ignore half armor.
A cybernetical replacement leg. Comes with a free foot.
Built-in hydraulics negates penalty for jumping. Must be paired.

Glowing tattoos. +2 to Wardrobe & Style if you have at least three installed.
Glowing tattoos. +2 to Wardrobe & Style if you have at least three installed.

Cost: 100eb (Premium) ♦ Install: Mall

Humanity Loss: 3 (1d6)

This Tyger Claw invention uses the simple trick of glowing ink to disrupt some of the smartest weapons in the world.

Requires 3 installations of Light Tattoos. Anyone targeting the user with Smart or Improved Smart Ammunition suffers a -2 penalty to their Attack Check. Counts as Gang Colors Jewelry, but only for the Tyger Claws. Might want to cover it up when not in Japantown.

Type: External Body Cyberware
Install: Mall
Option Slots: uses 1

Foundry notes:

  • The -2 applies to other people's checks, so it can't be automated from this item.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Cyberware > External Body Cyberware).

Primary Effect

Dose lasts 4 hours.

  • +1 REF by 1 point for the duration
  • The user feels paranoid occasionally

Secondary Effect (DV15)

  • -2 REF unless under the Primary Effect
  • GM will tell you when when you crave more Synthcoke. Roleplay accordingly.
